description: The tip is the state after the chain and the work of 2026-11-13 and 2026-11-14. It has the corrections of the optimizer, of the checkers and of the runtime, the new benchmark examples (134 ports of rbenchmark and RBenchmarking in eight categories), `KeyBenchmark`, and the GNU-R fallback of the test interpreter, which gives the optimizer feedback for more of each example. The timed runs of all sections use this commit.
runNotes: PLACEHOLDER: one paragraph from the coordinator about the timed runs: the machine, the states that were measured again and why, and the check of each state.
